definitions.explanation: A physically deep spot, such as a deep part of a river, pool, or body of water.
Abstract depth or richness in quality, such as depth of flavor, color, meaning, or character.

examples.english: I lost my footing in a deep part of the river.

examples.japanese: {深|ふか}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧はまらないよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気|き}をつけて。
examples.english: Be careful not to get in over your head.
examples.notes: Can refer literally to deep water or figuratively to getting too deeply involved.

examples.english: This pool gets deeper the further back you go.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧⟦とともに→とともに：30485_totomoni⟧⟦{味|あじ}わい→味わい：11899_ajiwai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{深|ふか}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: The flavor gained depth with age.
This painting has depth of color.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{積|つ}む→積む：02294_tsumu⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{深|ふか}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ま}す→増す：02422_masu⟧。
examples.english: By accumulating experience, one gains depth as a person.

notes:
USAGE:
Formed from ⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧ (deep) + the suffix ～み (which forms nouns indicating degree or quality). The figurative sense (sense 2) is particularly common, used to describe richness or profundity in abstract qualities.

The expression {深|ふか}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧はまる means both "to step into deep water" literally and "to get in too deep" figuratively.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {深|ふか}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ま}す→増す：02422_masu⟧: to gain depth
- {深|ふか}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have depth
- {深|ふか}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧はまる: to get in too deep
- ⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{深|ふか}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have depth of flavor
